description.value: A multivariate fMRI study of naturalistic emotion processing, classifying emotional conditions and developmental age groups using support vector machines.

spans.text: We employed a multivariate approach in order to elucidate distinctions in complex, naturalistic emotion processing between childhood and adulthood.

description.value: Observational cross-sectional comparison of adults and children during a naturalistic movie-viewing fMRI task.

value: The negative condition SVC successfully classified adults versus children with accuracy greater than 69.61%, above theoretical and simulated chance levels, with high sensitivity and precision.

The results may point to important developmental shifts from childhood to adulthood in visual processing of negative content, specifically decreased engagement of social and sensory integration regions and increased emotion regulation engagement in adults compared to children.
